nodes.label: DSpark: Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation
nodes.author: Xin Cheng et al.

nodes.label: DSpark confidence-scheduled speculative decoding
nodes.rationale: Adds sequential dependency to a parallel drafter and uses calibrated confidence scores to decide how much of a draft block is worth verifying, avoiding wasted verification compute on unlikely-to-survive tokens.
